name: HelpCenter
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Shopify helpdesk with live chat and an AI FAQ builder: email, chat and Messenger in one ticket queue, plus SEO-friendly FAQ pages.
best_for: small Shopify stores that want ticketing, live chat and a searchable FAQ page from one app rather than bolting three together
skip_if: you already run a general helpdesk like Zendesk or Freshdesk for a business wider than the store — this is Shopify-shaped, not company-shaped
honest_knock: The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay. But the meter is tickets, not agents: Basic hands you unlimited support staff and then charges $0.16 for every ticket past fifty. At 300 tickets a month that is $45.99, against $19.99 for the Standard tier that includes them outright — so check your own ticket volume before you treat $5.99 as the price. One dependency worth knowing: translating FAQs into other languages is handed off to a separate app (LangShop), so a multilingual store is two subscriptions, not one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month, or $59.99 a year
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-08-29 on apps.shopify.com/helpcenter) Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents — Basic already gives unlimited support agents, then bills for every ticket over the allowance. Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that. Basic is $5.99 a month or $59.99 a year, a 17% saving, and covers 50 tickets, then $0.16 each. Standard is $19.99 or $199.99 a year for 300 tickets, then $0.15. Advanced is $49.99 or $498.96 a year for 1,000 tickets, then $0.10. Every paid tier carries a 14-day free trial and all charges are billed in USD. Which means the headline $5.99 only holds to 50 tickets a month: at 300 tickets Basic works out at $45.99, because the 250 over the allowance add $40 — while Standard includes those same 300 for $19.99. Price the tier against your own ticket count rather than the entry rate. The App Store lists it as “SB: Helpdesk, Live Chat & FAQs” from Shark Byte, Inc — the product calls itself HelpCenter, so you will see both names. Rating 4.5 from 243 reviews.
